## Validity rules

A country is used on the result pages if all of the following hold:

| Check | Rule |
|---|---|
| Output present | BF-NEE summary for all 4 periods |
| Pipeline v3 | summary contains the v3 columns (cropland / pasture split) |
| Scale | LandSHIFT cell area ≤ 1,000 km² (old outputs were in m²) |
| Commodity data | LandSHIFT crop areas available (commodity shares not all missing) |
| Class split | ecosystem-class losses add up to the constrained total (rel. error < 10⁻⁶) |
| Constraint | constrained loss ≤ unconstrained loss in every period |
| Land-use split | BF-NEE of cropland + pasture = total BF-NEE |
| GlobES coupling | adjusted GlobES composition sums to 1 in every cell (step 04) |

## Countries not used

```{r}
excl <- countries %>%
  filter(!valid_for_analysis) %>%
  transmute(ISO3 = iso3, Country = coalesce(country_name, iso3), Reason = reason_invalid)

if (nrow(excl) == 0) {
  cat("All countries pass the checks.")
} else {
  bf_table(excl)
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
if (nrow(excl) > 0) {
  excl %>%
    count(Reason) %>%
    mutate(Reason = forcats::fct_reorder(Reason, n)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(n, Reason)) +
    geom_col(fill = bf_ink$other, width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.3, size = 3.4, colour = bf_ink$secondary) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = "Reasons for exclusion", x = "Countries", y = NULL) +
    theme_bfnee(grid = "x")
}
```

## Pipeline status

Latest checkpoint of every step and country (`Pipeline_Status`).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.6
if (!is.null(pipeline_status)) {
  ps <- pipeline_status %>%
    mutate(step = factor(step, levels = unique(step)),
           status = factor(status, levels = c("success", "failed", "not run")))

  ps %>%
    count(step, status) %>%
    ggplot(aes(n, step, fill = status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(success = "#0ca30c", failed = "#d03b3b", `not run` = bf_ink$other),
                      name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    labs(title = "Checkpoints per pipeline step", x = "Countries", y = NULL) +
    theme_bfnee(grid = "x")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(pipeline_status)) {
  pipeline_status %>%
    filter(status != "success") %>%
    transmute(ISO3 = iso3, Step = step, Status = status, Time = time,
              Error = substr(coalesce(error, ""), 1, 200)) %>%
    bf_table(page_length = 10)
}
```

## GlobES–LandSHIFT coupling (step 04)

After the coupling every cell must sum to one, the GlobES cropland classes must equal
LandSHIFT cropland, and 14.2 must equal LandSHIFT intensive pasture. Small pasture
differences occur only where LandSHIFT cropland + pasture exceed the cell and are scaled down.
Cells without any GlobES cover (sum 0) are set to NA in step 05 and ignored here.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.8
if (!is.null(coupling_checks) && nrow(coupling_checks) > 0) {
  cc_long <- coupling_checks %>%
    filter(iso3 %in% countries$iso3) %>%
    transmute(iso3, year,
              `|Σ classes − 1|` = pmax(ifelse(class_sum_min == 0, 0, abs(class_sum_min - 1)),
                                       abs(class_sum_max - 1)),
              `|cropland − LandSHIFT|` = crop_diff_max_abs,
              `|pasture − LandSHIFT|` = pasture_diff_max_abs) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(iso3, year), names_to = "check", values_to = "max_abs") %>%
    mutate(max_abs = pmax(max_abs, 1e-17))

  ggplot(cc_long, aes(factor(year), max_abs)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.6, colour = bf_brand$primary, size = 1.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ check) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(title = "Largest deviation per country and year",
         subtitle = "Fractions of a grid cell, log scale",
         x = NULL, y = "Max. absolute deviation") +
    theme_bfnee(grid = "xy")
}
```

## Consistency of the valid countries

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
chk <- ct %>%
  mutate(rel_error = pmax(class_sum_rel_error, 1e-17))

ggplot(chk, aes(period, rel_error)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1e-6, colour = "#d03b3b", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.6, colour = bf_brand$primary, size = 1.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 1e-6, label = "tolerance 10⁻⁶", vjust = -0.6, hjust = 0,
           colour = "#d03b3b", size = 3.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Ecosystem classes add up to the total",
       subtitle = "Relative difference between Σ classes and total constrained loss, per country",
       x = NULL, y = "Relative difference (log)")
```

## All countries

```{r}
countries %>%
  transmute(ISO3 = iso3, Country = coalesce(country_name, iso3), Region = continent,
            Valid = valid_for_analysis, `v3` = is_v3, Periods = n_transitions,
            `Scale OK` = scale_ok, `Commodity data` = has_commodity_shares,
            `Classes add up` = classes_add_up,
            `Max cell area (km²)` = round(cell_area_max_km2, 1),
            Reason = reason_invalid) %>%
  bf_table(page_length = 15)
```
